sub_graphs.title: EIP-7892: Blob Parameter Schedule and Base Fee Computation
sub_graphs.description: Models how blob gas parameters are configured via the blob schedule and how the base fee per blob gas is computed at runtime using the updated formulas.

nodes.label: Blob Schedule Loaded from Config
nodes.description: The client has loaded the blobSchedule configuration containing per-fork target, max, and baseFeeUpdateFraction values.

nodes.label: Parent Block Header Available
nodes.description: The parent block header with its excess_blob_gas and blob_gas_used fields is available for computation.

nodes.label: Calculate Excess Blob Gas
nodes.description: Compute excess blob gas using parent header and blob schedule: replaces TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK with GAS_PER_BLOB * blob_schedule.target.

nodes.label: Excess Blob Gas Value Computed
nodes.description: The excess blob gas value for the current block has been determined.

nodes.label: Calculate Base Fee Per Blob Gas
nodes.description: Compute the blob base fee using the excess blob gas and the blob_schedule.baseFeeUpdateFraction parameter.

nodes.label: Blob Base Fee Determined
nodes.description: The blob base fee for the current block is known and can be used for transaction validation and inclusion.

edges.label: Provide target and max blob counts for computation
Use excess gas to compute base fee
Output blob base fee for the block

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7892: BPO Fork Activation State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition when a BPO (Blob Parameter Only) fork activates at the execution and consensus layers, including timestamp-based EL activation and epoch-based CL activation.

nodes.label: Pre-BPO Fork Active Parameters
nodes.description: System is running with the previous blob parameter set (target, max, baseFeeUpdateFraction).

nodes.label: Check EL Fork Activation Timestamp
nodes.description: Execution layer checks if the current block timestamp >= the bpo<index>Time activation timestamp.

nodes.label: Check CL Fork Activation Epoch
nodes.description: Consensus layer checks if the current epoch matches a BLOB_SCHEDULE entry epoch after ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH.

nodes.label: Switch to New Blob Parameters
nodes.description: Both layers switch to the new blob schedule entry parameters (target, max, baseFeeUpdateFraction on EL; MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK on CL).

nodes.label: Post-BPO Fork Active Parameters
nodes.description: System is now running with the updated blob parameters from the new BPO fork entry.

edges.label: On new block, check EL activation
On new epoch, check CL activation

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7892: P2P Fork Digest Rotation at BPO Forks
sub_graphs.description: Models how ENR nfd (next fork digest) field and gossip topic ForkDigestValues rotate when BPO forks activate, ensuring peer discovery and topic compatibility.

nodes.label: ENR Next Fork Digest Set
nodes.description: Node ENR contains the nfd field advertising the upcoming BPO fork digest to peers.

nodes.label: Rotate Fork Digest Value
nodes.description: At BPO fork activation, the ForkDigestValue changes, causing automatic gossip topic rotation.

nodes.label: Gossip Topics Using New Fork Digest
nodes.description: All gossip topics now use the new ForkDigestValue; peers must subscribe to the new topics.

nodes.label: Peer Discovery ENR Updated
nodes.description: Node has updated its ENR to reflect the active fork and the next upcoming fork digest.

edges.label: ENR nfd updated to next upcoming fork

external_entities.name: Peer Node
external_entities.description: Other network participants that discover this node via ENR and subscribe to gossip topics.

ambiguities.text: No security risks have been identified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this applies only to the parameter-change mechanism itself and does not cover risks from specific parameter values (e.g., setting max too high). This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when EL and CL blob schedules are misaligned.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume misaligned schedules constitute a configuration error that clients should detect at startup. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: EL and CL blob schedules are always configured consistently, with EL max matching CL MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK and EL timestamps aligning with CL epoch boundaries.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent blob limits between layers could cause valid CL blocks to fail EL validation or vice versa, leading to chain splits or stuck finality.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes on the network upgrade their blobSchedule configuration before the activation timestamp/epoch.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes with stale configuration would reject blocks with the new blob parameters, causing network partitions.
